answer_1.quote: We propose BLONDE, an automatic metric that evaluates translation quality at the document level. ... We curate a large-scale document-level parallel corpus (BWB) ...

answer_2.quote: We compare BLONDE with 11 other metrics... BLEU, METEOR, TER, ROUGE-L, CIDER, LC, RC, SKIP, AVER, VECTOR, GREEDY ...

answer_4.quote: Our human assessment is provided by four professional Chinese to English translators and four native English revisers. ... We conduct the evaluation experiment with a 2 × 2 mixed factorial design, carrying both DOCUMENT-level and SENTENCE-level evaluation in terms of ADEQUACY and FLUENCY.
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluate translations for adequacy and fluency using relative ranking (RR) of system outputs.
